fields.description: Bit-packed per-level/stage progress entries (24 iterations) plus one u32 word per entry, serialized by FUN_08008f50 into EEPROM blocks 0x00-0x3d. Internal entry boundaries are table-driven (ROM length tables), so the region is mapped as one block.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008f50 load loop lines ~1178-1208 and save loop lines ~1345-1376 copy uVar23[i] bit-packed bytes plus 4-byte words for iVar21 in 0..0x17 between the EEPROM stream cursor (*_DAT_08009300 / *_DAT_0800968c) and the 24 x 0x20 live structs at _DAT_08009318.

fields.description: Stored byte-sum checksum slot of the progress record (last 2 bytes of EEPROM blocks 0x00-0x3d). Reads 0x0000 in the baseline, which does not equal seed 0x25 plus the data sum, so the boot code treats progress as fresh and re-initializes it.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008f50 reads the final 2 stream bytes into asStack_24 and compares sVar1 == asStack_24[0] (lines ~1324-1332); mismatch takes the re-init branch.
fields.name: progress_checksum

fields.description: Options/config word persisted in EEPROM blocks 0x3e-0x3f. Baseline holds the firmware default 0x0003e800 written by the verify-fail path.

fields.name: config_options_word
